::: {.page-lead}
When I'm away from eye-trackers and computational models, I'm usually chasing light with analog film cameras. Photography, to me, is a deliberate study of human perspective, optics, and framing—just executed offline. Here are a few favorite frames captured on 35mm film.
:::
